# Alexandre Vargas Lopez — Fullstack Developer

> Personal portfolio of Alexandre Vargas Lopez, a French fullstack developer based in Bordeaux, France. Available for freelance and collaboration.

## About

Alexandre Vargas Lopez is a fullstack developer with expertise in modern web technologies including React, Next.js, Vue.js, TypeScript, Go, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Docker. He specializes in building real-time SaaS applications, automation platforms, and end-to-end web solutions.

- Email: alexandre.vargas.lopez@gmail.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/alexandre-vl
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/alexandre-vargas-lopez-1b6450233/
- X / Twitter: https://twitter.com/alexx_vrgs
- Location: Bordeaux, France

## Projects

### Devolab — Web Agency (2023–present)
**Problem:** Local businesses in Bordeaux needed affordable, high-quality web presence with reliable hosting.
**Approach:** Co-founded a web agency delivering custom sites with SEO optimization, deployed on self-managed servers for full control.
**Outcome:** Delivering end-to-end web solutions for multiple clients — design, development, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.
- Stack: Vue.js, Vite, Node.js, SEO
- URL: https://www.devolab.net

### Ontrace — SaaS Platform (2024–present)
**Problem:** Vinted resellers needed real-time product detection and automated purchasing to compete in a fast-moving marketplace.
**Approach:** Built a full SaaS platform with millisecond-level product feed, automated purchasing engine, advanced filter management, and multi-tenant organization support — all powered by WebSocket for live updates.
**Outcome:** Active platform serving paying subscribers with real-time feeds, CRM, order tracking, and built-in messaging.
- Stack: Next.js, React, Go, WebSocket, Redis, PostgreSQL

### Upsky — Trading Platform (2023)
**Problem:** Retail traders wanted to replicate strategies from professional traders without manual execution.
**Approach:** Built a copy-trading platform with direct MetaTrader 5 integration for real-time order execution, trader discovery, and strategy analytics.
**Outcome:** Fully functional backend connected to live MetaTrader APIs. Not launched commercially.
- Stack: Vue.js, Node.js, MetaTrader 5, WebSocket, REST APIs

### Yaprof — Mobile PWA (2022)
**Problem:** French high school students had no collaborative way to track teacher absences in real time.
**Approach:** Created an open-source PWA connecting to Pronote with a social feed where students report absences — verified by community upvotes/downvotes.
**Outcome:** Open-source project with gamification layer (coins, profiles), available on GitHub.
- Stack: Vue 3, Pronote API, PWA, Capacitor
- GitHub: https://github.com/Yaprof/yaprof-app

### Homeflix — Discord Bot (2022)
**Problem:** Friend groups wanted to host movie nights on Discord but lacked scheduling and streaming tools.
**Approach:** Built a Discord bot that schedules screenings and streams movies directly into voice channels using FFmpeg transcoding.
**Outcome:** Community tool enabling movie catalog browsing, voting, and live session joining.
- Stack: Node.js, Discord.js, FFmpeg

### Playbot — Desktop Application (2023)
**Problem:** Gamers needed a way to find teammates matched by skill level and game preferences in real time.
**Approach:** Built a full desktop application with matchmaking, daily quests, coin rewards, global leaderboard, friend lists, and live game detection.
**Outcome:** Complete product with subscription tier. Not launched commercially.
- Stack: Electron, Nuxt.js, NestJS
